svg.title: Construction 1: 51 blocks on twelve coordinates from a 1-factorisation of K6
svg.desc: Two copies of the complete graph on six vertices, each with its fifteen edges in five colours. Curves through five hubs join every edge on the left to every edge of the same colour on the right; each such pair of edges is a block of four coordinates carrying sixteen sign vectors, drawn as a 4-cube.
